standard_prerequisites.name: Injectivity of the adjunction map along a surjective morphism
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the standard fact that the adjunction map F -> pi_*pi^{-1}F is injective when pi is surjective, checked on stalks
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the injectivity of F -> pi_*pi^{-1}F' used to reduce the assertion to the pullback of that pushforward.

standard_prerequisites.name: Base change for an injective coefficient sheaf
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma reducing the base change property for a coefficient sheaf to the corresponding property for a subsheaf
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the reduction of the base change map for F to the base change map for pi_*pi^{-1}F'.

standard_prerequisites.name: Commutation of the higher direct images with an integral base change, and the relative Leray spectral sequence
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemmas that the pushforward along an integral morphism commutes with base change and that the higher direct images along a composite behave as in the relative Leray spectral sequence
standard_prerequisites.use: Supply the three identifications R^q g_* pi_* F' = R^q g'_* F', e^{-1} pi_* F' = pi'_*(e')^{-1}F' and R^q h_* pi'_*(e')^{-1}F' = R^q h'_*(e')^{-1}F'.

core_obligations: Use the surjectivity of pi (proof lines 16976-16980): the adjunction map F -> pi_*pi^{-1}F' is injective because pi is surjective, which is checked on stalks.

Reduce to the pushed forward coefficient sheaf (proof lines 16980-16983): by the cited reduction lemma it suffices to prove that the base change map (f')^{-1}R^q g_*pi_*F' -> R^q h_*e^{-1}pi_*F' is an isomorphism.

Identify the two sides with the primed situation (proof lines 16983-16992): the three identities R^q g_*pi_*F' = R^q g'_*F', e^{-1}pi_*F' = pi'_*(e')^{-1}F' and R^q h_*pi'_*(e')^{-1}F' = R^q h'_*(e')^{-1}F' hold by the compatibility of the higher direct images with integral base change and by the relative Leray spectral sequence, so the required isomorphism is exactly the assumed one.
proof_roadmap: Note that the adjunction map along the surjective integral morphism pi is injective.
Reduce the base change property for F to the corresponding property for the pushforward of its pullback.
Rewrite the higher direct images along the integral morphism using the commutation with base change and the relative Leray spectral sequence.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that in the base change situation, if the base change map holds after an integral surjective base change pi : T' -> T, then it holds before it (statement lines 16938-16974). The proof (proof lines 16976-16994) uses the injectivity of the adjunction map along the surjective morphism to reduce, then rewrites the two sides through the commutation of the higher direct images with integral base change and the relative Leray spectral sequence. H2: one reduction and three identifications, written out in full.
